description: Ministry of Finance - Import and Export (Control) Act No. 1 of 1969
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations promulgated under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, establishing new payment term requirements for importers. It creates legal/regulatory frameworks for foreign trade transactions, specifies compliance procedures with Customs, and amends previous regulations. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel appointment. The content is primarily about establishing legal requirements for import/export controls.
